pages.text: God's people came to the land He had promised them. Joshua was their new leader. A big city called Jericho had tall, strong walls.
God told Joshua, "March around the city once a day for six days." The priests carried the Ark of the Covenant and blew trumpets.
On the seventh day, they marched around the city seven times. Then the priests blew their trumpets, and the people gave a great shout!
The walls of Jericho came tumbling down! God helped His people because they listened and did what He asked.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: God's plan sounded strange, but Joshua listened and trusted. When we listen to God, He helps us.
